description: Create an @cherami.to inbox at the address chosen with the human.

idempotency_key.description: Retain a unique key, exact payload and first request time per intended creation. Reuse only within 24 hours; replay returns current names, not the original settings.

local_part.description: Immutable part before @cherami.to; 1–64 letters, numbers, hyphens and underscores after trimming, with alphanumeric ends. Lowercased on creation.

name.description: Optional internal inbox name shared by the account; not the public sender identity. At most 256 UTF-8 bytes.

sender_name.description: Optional public name recipients see on subsequent outgoing mail. At most 256 UTF-8 bytes.

name: create_inbox

created_at.description: Absolute ISO 8601 service timestamp in UTC (Z), with millisecond precision.

idempotency_expires_at.description: End of creation-key protection; do not retry uncertain creation after this instant.
